text:
zoe.design: Quick UX check on the batch inputs + vectors preview: users in usability said the relevance table feels noisy when compact density is on. Also export dropdown labels are ambiguous. Can we tighten up copy and tab order? :mag:
carlos.pm: can you list the main asks?
zoe.design: 1) compact row spacing should still show metadata tooltip, 2) default sort should be score desc, 3) export labels need to indicate format and whether metadata is included.
hema.a11y: accessibility: ensure truncation uses aria-label with full text; tooltips must be reachable by keyboard (aria-describedby). Table must use role="grid" and each cell get role="gridcell" when interactive.
ben.fe: implementation notes: I can add aria-labels and a focusable tooltip target. For export we currently have:
```
Export -> menu: [Export CSV, Export JSON, Export selected]
```
I propose changing to:
```
Download CSV (vectors, metadata)
Download CSV (vectors only)
Download JSON (vectors + metadata)
```
so users know what's included.
zoe.design: love that. Also change visible button to 'Download' and show selected option summary to the right, e.g., 'CSV · with metadata · 24 rows'.
carlos.pm: on sorting: standardize server-side to return score desc by default and client can toggle. Document in release notes.
hema.a11y: also request live region announce on export completion: "Download ready: vectors-20260315-24.csv" and move focus to the download link. Use aria-atomic and aria-relevant for the region.
ben.fe: will add the live region and ensure focus only moves after announcement to avoid double reads. Also I'll fix tab order: toolbar DOM will be copy -> download -> options to match visual order.
export-bot: export-checker: csv-quoting: PASS; a11y-mini-scan: WARN (tooltip not reachable via keyboard in current branch).
zoe.design: thanks — I'll update Figma: tooltip target, button copy, and export summary. Can we ship this with the next patch?
carlos.pm: yes, target patch. Ben, ping here when PR is up so Hema can test.
hema.a11y: will try to validate on NVDA/VO once PR lands.
ben.fe: PR later today. ETA review tomorrow morning.
zoe.design: great, thanks team! :sparkles:
